info.description: Administration API of ONE Axi store (the store is derived from the token). Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. POST requires an Idempotency-Key. Business rules are the same as the Axi MCP server. Guide: docs/API-REST.md.

parameters.name: Axi-Webhook-Id
parameters.description: Event id: identical on retries and replays, deduplicate on it

parameters.name: Axi-Signature
parameters.description: v1 = hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + "." + raw body)); two v1 values during a 24 h secret rotation; reject when |now - t| > 300 s

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Respond within 10 s; redirects are not followed; anything else is retried (1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, 12 h, 24 h).

bearerAuth.description: Store API token (Intégrations > Connecteurs IA). Effective access = token scopes ∩ plan ∩ creator role. Plans: Business = read-only, Scale and Enterprise = read and write.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per request (UUID v4 recommended), kept 24 h. Same key + same request: stored response replayed with Idempotent-Replayed: true. Same key + different request: 422.
